description: Attach local file(s) to the page WITHOUT opening the OS file picker (the picker cannot be automated — never click elements that open it). Pass the ref of a file input (hidden ones appear in snapshots as 'file-input ... [hidden]'), or of an upload button/dropzone near it, plus absolute local file paths. Sets the input's files directly, or simulates a drag-and-drop when no file input is found.

mode.description: auto (default): find and fill the file input. drop: force a drag-and-drop onto the ref'd element (for dropzones).

paths.description: Absolute paths of local files to attach.

ref.description: Ref of the file input, upload button, or dropzone.

name: browser_upload_file
